title: Laid off at 59. Then she moved to Antarctica.
caption:
Laid off at 59 after more than three decades at HP. Her next job was at the bottom of the planet.

Would you take it?

Story via Business Insider.

#antarctica #layoff #careerchange #reinvention #mcmurdo

scenes.vo: Thirty years at one company. Then one day it was over, and her next job was at the bottom of the planet.
May Lee joined HP in 1987 as an intern. She stayed for over three decades. At 59, she was laid off.
She applied everywhere in tech. She used every contact she had. Nothing worked.
She'd been to Antarctica twice, just on holiday. She wondered: can you actually work there? It turns out you can.
She became a supply technician at McMurdo Station, handling cargo, tracking inventory and doing hard physical work. The pay was much lower. She loved it anyway.
And now, at 60, she's going back. This time as a broadcast engineer.
A layoff isn't always the end of the story. Sometimes it's the first page. Would you take this job? Comment below.
